verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly offer an API explorer with request schemas, code examples and an API playground. Copy-paste examples are documented in cURL, Python and TypeScript, and a probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which backs the reference. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the playground actually executes live requests, and detail on reference depth (per-endpoint coverage, auth in the playground); the playground evidence is a single one-line claim.
